policies.note: Enforcing tenant. Reaching the limit is a hard stop: the next metered ERP operation is refused budget-exhausted, and nothing is written for it.

Observing tenant on a soft cap: overrunning is reported (warn/would_warn) and the alert feed carries the breach, but the operation is never refused. This is the platform's own soft-cap semantics, deliberately not re-implemented here.
Daily-window enforcing tenant: the same ladder evaluated over the UTC day bucket instead of the month, which is what a tenant with bursty end-of-month postings wants.
